annotations.text: Habit won a six-way build. The finding that outlived the five alternatives: all of them independently chose a COMPOSITE preview over active-tab-only, and the literal spec build showed why — read literally each tab owns its own calendar, so a coach cannot see a Monday collision until validation rejects it.

The client booking flow, end to end, in the Forest theme.

The three-month window on step 1 is a UI restriction only — nothing validates against it server-side, which is what lets a recurring booking run past it.

CHOSEN: Timeline, the measured strip. Width IS duration — a 60-minute lesson occupies twice the space of a 30-minute one, and the two-hour midday gap is real empty space rather than a label.

Open problem carried forward: that squeezes the 30-minute slots narrow enough that their labels rotate 90°. Needs a rethink at phone width, not a reflow.

The student picker in the header is not in the spec — added because price resolves from the student's override before the block price, so the page cannot render a price until it knows who the lesson is for.
Partial success is the normal case, not an error state. The reason is deliberately merged — saying \"already taken\" would leak that another family holds that slot.
